def _capture_stdout(argv, ignore_retval=False):
    import subprocess
    p = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    stdout = p.stdout.read()
    retval = p.wait()
    if retval and not ignore_retval:
        raise RuntimeError("error running '%s'" % ' '.join(argv))
    return stdout
